description: Ligações Aéreas 2019-2020 - Acessibilidade Geográfica e Temporal – Configuração espacial da demanda e tempo de deslocamento para acesso às Cidades com aeroportos is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Mapa exibindo a configuração espacial da demanda, com base no perfil de deslocamento dos passageiros embarcados (locais x regionais) e seus tempos médios ponderados de acesso (TMPac). Brasil - 2019. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Ligações aéreas - Brasil, Rede Urbana, Acessibilidade, geoscientificInformation, transportation. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
